title: Interpret Hospital Station Stacklight States (Solid/Flashing Colors)
summary: Use the hospital station stacklight color and flashing pattern to determine the current station condition: Default/Indeterminate, No AGV present, RMS error, Fault, or AGV present (flashing yellow for 15 seconds).
when_to_use: When you need to identify the current hospital station condition by observing the station stacklight (solid vs flashing colors).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Visually observe the hospital station stacklight and map the observed solid/flashing color pattern to the documented station condition.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the hospital station stacklight

system_preconditions: Hospital station has a stacklight that illuminates in sections.

visual_references.description: Figure showing the hospital station stacklight state mapping: Solid Red (Default/Indeterminate), Solid Green (No AGV present), Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error), Flashing Red (Fault), Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds (AGV present at either position).
Photo of the hospital station showing the physical station and stacklight context.

steps.title: Locate the hospital station stacklight
steps.purpose: Identify the correct stacklight to observe for the station condition.
steps.instruction: Locate the hospital station’s stacklight (each hospital station has one stacklight).
steps.expected_result: You can visually see the hospital station stacklight that illuminates in sections.
steps.healthy_condition: The correct stacklight for the hospital station is visible and observable.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot clearly identify the stacklight for the intended hospital station.

actions.label: Visually locate stacklight
actions.exact_action: Locate the hospital station’s stacklight (each hospital station has one stacklight).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Each hospital station has one stacklight that illuminates in sections to give information about actions at the station.

steps.title: Observe whether the stacklight is solid or flashing
steps.purpose: Determine which stacklight mapping applies (solid vs flashing patterns).
steps.instruction: Observe the stacklight indication and note whether it is solid or flashing.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the stacklight pattern as solid or flashing (and which colors are lit).
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklight colors and solid/flashing behavior are clearly observable.
steps.failure_condition: The stacklight pattern is unclear (e.g., cannot determine solid vs flashing or which colors are lit).

actions.label: Check solid vs flashing
actions.exact_action: Observe the stacklight indication and note whether it is solid or flashing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Stacklight state mapping includes solid red/solid green/red+yellow+green/flashing red/flashing yellow for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Map Solid Red to Default/Indeterminate
steps.purpose: Classify the station condition based on the documented stacklight state.
steps.instruction: If the stacklight is Solid Red, record the state as Default/Indeterminate.
steps.expected_result: Recorded station condition = Default/Indeterminate when Solid Red is observed.
steps.healthy_condition: Solid Red is observed and the recorded state matches Default/Indeterminate.
steps.failure_condition: Solid Red is observed but the recorded state is not Default/Indeterminate.

actions.label: Record Default/Indeterminate
actions.exact_action: If the stacklight is Solid Red, record the state as Default/Indeterminate.

steps.title: Map Solid Green to No AGV present
steps.purpose: Classify the station condition based on the documented stacklight state.
steps.instruction: If the stacklight is Solid Green, record the state as No AGV present at the station.
steps.expected_result: Recorded station condition = No AGV present at the station when Solid Green is observed.
steps.healthy_condition: Solid Green is observed and the recorded state matches No AGV present at the station.
steps.failure_condition: Solid Green is observed but the recorded state is not No AGV present at the station.

actions.label: Record No AGV present
actions.exact_action: If the stacklight is Solid Green, record the state as No AGV present at the station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Solid Green: No AGV present at the station.

steps.title: Map Red+Yellow+Green to RMS error
steps.purpose: Classify the station condition based on the documented stacklight state.
steps.instruction: If the stacklight shows Red, Yellow, and Green simultaneously, record the state as RMS error.
steps.expected_result: Recorded station condition = RMS error when Red+Yellow+Green are simultaneously lit.
steps.healthy_condition: Red, Yellow, and Green are simultaneously observed and the recorded state matches RMS error.
steps.failure_condition: Red+Yellow+Green are observed but the recorded state is not RMS error.

actions.label: Record RMS error
actions.exact_action: If the stacklight shows Red, Yellow, and Green simultaneously, record the state as RMS error.

steps.title: Map Flashing Red to Fault
steps.purpose: Classify the station condition based on the documented stacklight state.
steps.instruction: If the stacklight is Flashing Red, record the state as Fault.
steps.expected_result: Recorded station condition = Fault when Flashing Red is observed.
steps.healthy_condition: Flashing Red is observed and the recorded state matches Fault.
steps.failure_condition: Flashing Red is observed but the recorded state is not Fault.

actions.label: Record Fault
actions.exact_action: If the stacklight is Flashing Red, record the state as Fault.

steps.title: Map Flashing Yellow (15 seconds) to AGV present
steps.purpose: Confirm AGV presence at the hospital station using the documented flashing duration.
steps.instruction: If the stacklight is Flashing Yellow, confirm it lasts for 15 seconds, then record the state as AGV is present at either position of the station.
steps.expected_result: Recorded station condition = AGV is present at either position of the station when Flashing Yellow persists for 15 seconds.
steps.healthy_condition: Flashing Yellow is observed and lasts for 15 seconds; recorded state matches AGV present at either position.
steps.failure_condition: Flashing Yellow is observed but does not last for 15 seconds, or the recorded state does not match the 15-second Flashing Yellow condition.

actions.label: Confirm 15-second duration
actions.exact_action: If the stacklight is Flashing Yellow, confirm it lasts for 15 seconds, then record the state as AGV is present at either position of the station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds: AGV is present at either position of the station.

success_criteria: Operator maps the observed hospital station stacklight solid/flashing color pattern to exactly one documented station condition: Default/Indeterminate, No AGV present, RMS error, Fault, or AGV present (15-second Flashing Yellow).
healthy_conditions: Solid Red observed and recorded as Default/Indeterminate.
Solid Green observed and recorded as No AGV present at the station.
Red+Yellow+Green simultaneously observed and recorded as RMS error.
Flashing Red observed and recorded as Fault.
Flashing Yellow observed and lasts for 15 seconds; recorded as AGV present at either position of the station.
failure_conditions: Observed stacklight pattern does not match any documented state (Solid Red, Solid Green, Red+Yellow+Green, Flashing Red, Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds).
Flashing Yellow is observed but duration is not confirmed as 15 seconds before recording AGV present.
escalation_guidance: If the observed stacklight pattern does not match any documented state, escalate (do not guess a station condition).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Solid Red: Default/Indeterminate; Solid Green: No AGV present at the station; Red, Yellow, Green: RMS error; Flashing Red: Fault; Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds: AGV is present at either position of the station

missing_details: No additional troubleshooting or next-step actions are provided in the source beyond mapping the stacklight state to the station condition.
